lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots posterior to the gill slits, with the most defined cluster located in the mid-lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows to form a semi-regular grid pattern across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance shift from light (dorsal) to shadow (ventral).

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 8-10 high-luminance blobs are visible, primarily concentrated within the ventral half of the first dorsal fin's lateral silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density cluster of small, high-luminance points in the cephalic region anterior to the first branchial slit.
